# Sonykun Design

> Sonykun Design is the Vancouver freelance web design studio of designer Sony Lin, serving small businesses in British Columbia since 2005. It offers affordable website design, logo design and website + brand bundles with transparent CAD pricing — websites and logos from $375 — and clients see a live preview of their website before they pay.

Sony Lin has designed 500+ websites over 20+ years for small businesses, clinics, contractors and restaurants. Sonykun Design handles the whole job: design, build, domain setup, hosting transfer and launch, in English or Traditional Chinese. Once a client pays, the website belongs to them; Sonykun can keep hosting it or hand over all the files.

The site is also available in Traditional Chinese under /zh/, e.g. https://sonykundesign.com/zh/.

## Pricing (CAD, no hidden fees)

Websites:
- One-Page Website — $375: single-page landing website, mobile-friendly, contact form, free hosting available, basic brand setup.
- Business Website — $750: up to 7 pages, mobile-optimised layout, SEO-friendly structure, contact form, free hosting available, basic branding integration.
- Premium Website — $1,250: up to 10 pages, advanced layout design, custom styling, SEO-optimised structure, enhanced brand presentation.
- E-commerce Basic — $1,680: online store setup, payment integration, 20 products included (up to 3 variants and 5 images each), mobile-friendly checkout. Extra products $75 per 10; bulk upload from client spreadsheet (50+ products) $3 each. Shopify monthly plan paid directly by the client.

Logo & branding:
- Basic Logo — $375: 2 initial concepts, 2 revision rounds, colour and monochrome versions, PNG and SVG files.
- Growth Logo — $650: 3 concepts, 3 revision rounds, brand colour palette, typography recommendations, logo variations, mini brand style guide.
- Premium Logo — $1,275: 4 revision rounds, extended variations, comprehensive brand guidelines, social media assets, business card design, brand templates.

Website + brand bundles:
- Starter Bundle — $800: One-Page Website + Basic Logo + business card design + basic on-page SEO.
- Business Bundle — $1,400: Business Website + Growth Logo + business card + mini brand style guide.
- Premium Brand Launch — $2,400: Premium Website + Premium Logo (incl. business card) + complete brand guidelines and strategic homepage planning.

Hosting: free hosting on Sonykun's platform (client owns the files and can move them anytime; changes $50 each); Managed Hosting is $20/month or $200/year (2 months free) and includes maintenance and up to 2 small edits per month. Additional revision rounds during a project are $75 each. Same price for every client.

## How it works

1. Tell Sonykun Design about your business.
2. Get a free website preview — see it before you pay.
3. Approve and pay; Sonykun finalizes everything, handles domain setup and hosting transfer, and launches the site.
